kitEvidence.formula:
Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds. He can Recast to spit them out.

Enemy Champions: Require 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste. Are devoured for up to [3] seconds and take [100 / 250 / 400] (+[0.15 + (0.0007) × AP] of their Max Health) magic damage. Tahm Kench is Slowed by [40]% and Grounded during this effect.

Ally Champions: Are devoured for up to [3] seconds and are granted [650 / 800 / 950 + (1) × AP] Shield which decays gradually after being spit out. Allies can also choose to exit early. Tahm Kench is Grounded during this effect, but can cast {{Spell_TahmKenchW_Name}} and gains [60]% Move Speed for [3] seconds.

builds.name: Tongue Lash: HP times AP crossover
builds.summary: Investigate a high Tongue Lash plus one passive application result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate a high Tongue Lash plus one passive application result under finite conditions, with a practical control and one-slot swaps. Candidate, not proof of a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 Q deals 255 + AP magic damage and applies one passive bonus. The passive contains a level-based base, 4% bonus HP and 0.000125 times bonus HP times AP. This HP-by-AP product makes a mixed health/AP inventory worth testing against all AP. Deathcap and Riftmaker interact with the observed AP pool; magic penetration affects both Q and passive.

kitEvidence.formula:
Deals [75 / 120 / 165 / 210 / 255 + (1) × AP] magic damage to the first enemy hit and Slows them by [50]% for [2] seconds. 

On champion hit, heals Tahm for [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50] +[(0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06 / 0.065 / 0.07) × 100]% of his missing Health and applies a stack of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }} dealing @Spell.TahmKenchPassive:TotalDamage@ extra magic damage. If that champion already had 3 stacks of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }}, they will also be Stunned for [1.5] seconds, consuming the stacks.

Activate Devour while your tongue is in midair to devour enemy champions who already have 3 stacks of {{ Spell_TahmKenchPassive_Name }} from a distance when you hit them.
